title: Cxrrvptxd's High Fps Modpack
description: 🚀 High FPS boosts Minecraft performance with powerful optimization mods, delivering higher frame rates, faster loading times, smoother gameplay, and reduced lag while preserving the classic Minecraft experience. Perfect for low-end and high-end PCs alike.
body: High FPS is a lightweight Minecraft optimization modpack designed to dramatically increase performance while keeping the vanilla experience intact. Whether you're playing on a low-end laptop or simply want smoother gameplay, this modpack focuses on maximizing FPS, reducing lag, improving chunk loading, and optimizing memory usage without changing how Minecraft feels. Enjoy faster loading times, stable performance, and a smoother adventure across every world you explore.
